content.thinking: My test file got mangled by the convoluted `if False else` expressions. Let me rewrite it cleanly and simply with a straightforward list of (expected, line) tuples, using bytes for the invalid-UTF-8 case.

content.text: My test file was over-convoluted. Let me rewrite it cleanly:

arguments.command:
cd /app/work && cat > errors_test.py << 'PYEOF'
import json
from driver import run

BASE_REPLAY = {"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1],[2]],[[10],[20]]],"slots":2,"window":1,
               "events":[["send",0,0]]}
BASE_AUDIT = {"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],
              "edges":[[0,"a",0]],"start":0,"fairness":[]}

def J(**kw):
    r = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE_REPLAY)); r.update(kw)
    return json.dumps(r)

def A(**kw):
    a = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE_AUDIT)); a.update(kw)
    return json.dumps(a)

cases = []
def case(exp, line, note):
    cases.append((exp, line, note))

# ---------------- E_JSON ----------------
case("E_JSON", "not json", "bare word")
case("E_JSON", "[1,2,3", "truncated")
case("E_JSON", '{"op":"replay","op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "dup key")
case("E_JSON", "   ", "whitespace only")
case("E_JSON", "", "empty line")
cases.append(("E_JSON", b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[],"x":"\xff\xfe"}', "invalid utf8"))
cases.append(("E_JSON", '{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1, "\\ud800"]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "surrogate escape"))
case("E_JSON", J(slots=None).replace('"window":1', '"slots":NaN'), "NaN token")
case("E_JSON", J().replace('"slots":2', '"slots":Infinity'), "Infinity token")
case("E_JSON", J().replace('"slots":2', '"slots":-Infinity'), "-Infinity token")
case("E_JSON", '{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1e999,"window":1,"events":[]}', "overflow float")
case("E_JSON", J().replace('"slots":2', '"slots":2.5'), "float slots (schema too)")
case("E_JSON", "[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[", "deep nesting")

# ---------------- E_SCHEMA (replay) ----------------
case("E_SCHEMA", J(extra=1), "unknown key")
case("E_SCHEMA", json.dumps({k:v for k,v in BASE_REPLAY.items() if k != "slots"}), "missing key")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs="x"), "inputs not a list")
case("E_SCHEMA", "[1,2,3]", "top-level not object")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(op="Replay"), "unknown op")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(op=5), "op wrong type")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(op=None), "op missing")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs=[[[1]],[[2]],[[3]]]), "nonrectangular P")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs=[[[1],[2]],[[1]]]), "nonrectangular R")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs=[[[1,2]],[[1]]]), "nonrectangular D")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs=[[[True]]]), "boolean value")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs=[[[1.5]]]), "float value")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs=[[[ "1" ]]]), "string value")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(inputs=[[[]], [[ ]], {"a":1}]), "row element not list")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(slots="2"), "slots string")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(window=True), "window bool")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=["send",0,0]), "event not array")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[["send",0,0,0]]), "event wrong arity")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[["SEND",0,0]]), "bad kind")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[["send",[0],0]]), "rank not int")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[["send",0,1.0]]), "q float")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[["retry",0,1]]), "retry arity")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[["deliver","0"]]), "deliver pid type")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[["duplicate",True]]), "pid bool")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events=[[]]), "empty event")
case("E_SCHEMA", J(events={"a":1}), "events not list")

# ---------------- E_LIMIT (replay) ----------------
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[[1]]]*9), "P=9")
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[[1]]*129]), "R=129")
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[[1]*33]]), "D=33")
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[[1000000001]]]), "value too big")
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[[-1000000001]]]), "value too small")
case("E_LIMIT", J(slots=17), "slots 17")
case("E_LIMIT", J(slots=0), "slots 0")
case("E_LIMIT", J(window=0), "window 0")
case("E_LIMIT", J(slots=2, window=3), "window>slots")
case("E_LIMIT", J(events=[["send",0,0]]*20001), "too many events")
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[[1],[2]]], window=2, events=[["send",0,2]]), "send q>=R")
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[[1],[2]]], events=[["send",5,0]]), "send rank>=P")
case("E_LIMIT", J(events=[["deliver",200001]]), "pid too big")
case("E_LIMIT", J(events=[["deliver",-1]]), "pid negative")
case("E_LIMIT", J(events=[["retry",9]]), "retry rank>=P")
case("E_LIMIT", J(inputs=[[]], events=[["send",0,0]]), "send when R=0")

# ---------------- E_SCHEMA (audit/export) ----------------
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[],"x":1}]), "state extra key")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[]]}]).replace("}"), "") if False else None
case("E_SCHEMA", json.dumps({"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}), "state missing key")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"ranks":[],"seq":0}]}]), "slot missing key")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"ranks":[],"seq":0,"sum":[2],"x":1}]}]), "slot extra key")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[[1]]],"slots":[{"ranks":[0,0],"seq":0,"sum":[1]}]}]), "dup rank in slot")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(edges=[[0,"a",0],[0,"a",0]]), "dup triple")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(fairness=[{"action":"a","mode":"weak"},{"action":"a","mode":"strong"}]), "dup fairness")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(fairness=[{"action":"a","mode":"sometimes"}]), "bad mode")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(fairness=[{"action":"0a","mode":"weak"}]), "name digit head")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(fairness=[{"action":"a-b","mode":"weak"}]), "name bad char")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(fairness=[{"action":"","mode":"weak"}]), "empty name")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(fairness=[{"action":True,"mode":"weak"}]), "action not str")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(edges=[[0,"a",0,0]]), "edge arity")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(edges=[["0","a",0]]), "edge source type")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(edges=[[0,1,0]]), "edge action not str")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(start="0"), "start type")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":1,"slots":[]}]), "delivered not list")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[0],"slots":[]}]), "row not list")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[True]],"slots":[]}]), "delivered bool")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[["x"]],"slots":[]}]), "delivered str")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":1}]), "slots not list")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(states=[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[1]}]), "slot not object")

# ---------------- E_LIMIT (audit/export) ----------------
case("E_LIMIT", A(states=[]), "zero states")
BIG = 1 << 60
case("E_LIMIT", A(states=[{"delivered":[[[BIG+1]]],"slots":[]}]), "value out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(states=[{"delivered":[[[-BIG-1]]],"slots":[]}]), "value small")
case("E_LIMIT", A(states=[{"delivered":[[[2]]],"slots":[{"ranks":[9],"seq":0,"sum":[2]}]}]), "rank out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(states=[{"delivered":[[[2]]],"slots":[{"ranks":[0],"seq":1,"sum":[2]}]}]), "slot seq out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(states=[{"delivered":[[[2]]],"slots":[{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2,2]}]}]), "slot sum width")
case("E_LIMIT", A(start=1), "start out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(start=-1), "start negative")
case("E_LIMIT", A(edges=[[0,"a",1]]), "edge target out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(fairness=[{"action":"a","mode":"weak"}]*17), "too many fairness objects (dup too)")
case("E_LIMIT", A(fairness=[{"action":"a"*65,"mode":"weak"}]), "name too long")
case("E_LIMIT", A(edges=[[0, "a"*65, 0]]), "edge name too long")
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(states=[{"delivered":[[[2]]],"slots":
    [{"ranks":[0],"seq":i,"sum":[2]} for i in range(17)]}]), "state with 17 slots"))
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(**{"states":[{"delivered":[[[2]]*3],"slots":[]}]}), "row longer than R"))
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(**{"states":[{"delivered":[[[1],[1],[2]]],"slots":[]}]}),
            "width mismatch vs D"))
# > 64 distinct names
e64 = [[0, "n%02d" % i, 0] for i in range(65)]
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(edges=e64), "65 distinct names"))
# valid boundary: 64 names OK
e64b = [[0, "n%02d" % i, 0] for i in range(64)]
cases.append((None, A(edges=e64b), "exactly 64 names (valid)"))
# empty tuple name set / empty edges OK
cases.append((None, A(edges=[]), "no edges valid"))
cases.append((None, A(fairness=[]), "no fairness valid"))
cases.append((None, json.dumps({"op":"export","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}), "export empty valid"))

cases = [c for c in cases if c]
bad = 0
for exp, line, note in cases:
    rows, err = run(line)
    got = rows[0]
    if exp is None:
        ok = "error" not in got
    else:
        ok = (got == {"error": exp})
    if not ok:
        bad += 1
        print("MISMATCH:", note, "| exp", exp, "| got", json.dumps(got)[:160])
print("error cases:", len(cases), "bad:", bad)
PYEOF
python3 errors_test.py 2>&1 | tail -25
